shape_statement: LITERAL READING IMPLEMENTED: a new stdlib-only write gate (scripts/lib/job_uuid_gate.py) plus its owned test battery (tests/unit/job-uuid-gate.test.py). It refuses a gated write when the expected recurring job UUID is wrong, missing, ambiguous, or not provably recurring, with no fallback of any kind (no first-match, no case folding, no whitespace trimming, no default job, no writing before refusal), and it emits a prebuilder receipt whose actual_recurring_job_id is derived exclusively from the observed scheduler listing, never from the expected value. NOT the shape implemented: wiring the gate into a live orchestrator caller, and NOT an authority-root-only evidence artefact (those artefacts are absent from disk now: find /Users/blackceomacmini -name 'prebuilder*' returned nothing).

claims: A write whose expected job UUID does not exactly match a single observed recurring job is refused before any filesystem mutation; no file, no parent directory, no temp file is created.
A refusal preserves pre-existing bytes at the target path (proved by test_refusal_preserves_existing_bytes).
Missing or non-string expected UUID, empty observation, ambiguous duplicate ids, and unstated/false recurrence each refuse with a distinct reason code.
Case-folded, whitespace-padded, and truncated variants of the correct UUID are refused (no normalisation fallback).

The prebuilder receipt is emitted only from a proven observation, and its actual_recurring_job_id equals the observed job id, not the expected one; it carries prompt_body_sha256 and prompt_body_bytes.
An unproven receipt attempt writes no receipt file.
